headline: AFP, US and Australia Complete 19th Maritime Cooperative Activity in West Philippine Sea
seoTitle: AFP, US, Australia Complete 19th MMCA in West Philippine Sea | FMB News
seoDescription: Philippine, US and Australian forces completed the 19th Multilateral Maritime Cooperative Activity in the West Philippine Sea after a week of naval and air exercises.
deck: The weeklong activity included maritime-domain awareness, anti-submarine warfare, replenishment at sea and joint maneuver exercises.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Naval and air units from the Philippines, United States and Australia completed the 19th Multilateral Maritime Cooperative Activity in the West Philippine Sea, the Armed Forces of the Philippines announced Wednesday.
The activity ran from August 19 to 25 and brought together units from the AFP, United States Pacific Command and Australian Defence Force.

sections.heading: What the exercise covered
paragraphs: According to the AFP, participating forces conducted communications exercises, maritime-domain awareness activities, anti-submarine warfare, replenishment at sea, division tactics and officer-of-the-watch maneuvers, a photo exercise and fly-by operations.

Philippine assets included BRP Diego Silang, an AW-109 naval helicopter, FA-50 aircraft, a C-208B surveillance aircraft and a W-3A Sokol search-and-rescue helicopter, alongside the Philippine Coast Guard's BRP Teresa Magbanua. The United States deployed USS Santa Barbara and a P-8A Poseidon, while Australia deployed HMAS Supply, an MH-60R helicopter and another P-8A.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The AFP said the activity was intended to improve maritime interoperability and operational coordination among participating forces and support a free, open and secure Indo-Pacific.
The exercise took place amid continued Philippine defense cooperation with treaty allies and regional partners in the West Philippine Sea.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Regular multilateral activities test whether participating forces can communicate, maneuver and sustain operations together at sea and in the air. They also carry diplomatic significance because they take place amid continuing disputes and competing maritime claims in the South China Sea.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The AFP has said multilateral maritime activities with partner nations will continue. Future iterations will show how the participating forces expand the complexity and frequency of joint operations.
